items.why: Chip stocks fell even as TSMC posted upbeat revenue, with higher oil prices and elevated Treasury yields weighing on the sector, per Barron's.
Crude jumped on an Iran strike-plan report, with Reuters noting the oil surge is dragging global equities lower.
Bitcoin broke below $83,000 after roughly $550 million in leveraged longs were liquidated and oil jumped on the Iran strike-plan report, per CoinDesk.
The AI-chip complex sagged with the sector as higher oil prices and elevated Treasury yields preoccupied investors despite strong TSMC results, per Barron's.

market_note: Futures soft midday: S&P -0.31%, Nasdaq -0.67%, VIX up 1.86%.
summary: Risk-off tilt midday. Oil jumped over 3% on an Iran strike-plan report while tech and crypto sold off under pressure from elevated yields, with AMD and Bitcoin the biggest laggards.
